concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-010 (Class Prior Baseline) is not linked to any task. No task creates, trains, or persists a Class Prior Baseline model, leaving FR-010 orphaned.

Functional Requirement FR-011 (Associative framing in reporting) lacks a dedicated task. There is no task ensuring the final report or README explicitly states that results are presented associatively, as required by FR-011.
Success Criterion SC-009 (Baseline‑convergence monitoring) is not covered by any task. No task checks or flags baseline accuracies below 55 %, so the criterion remains unverified.
